title: Toll Tag Statement Upload Gap
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tolltag:trip
| stats max(_time) as last_trip by transponder_id
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_trip)/86400,1)
| where days_since>30
| sort - days_since
description: Uses Toll-tag trip exports telemetry to monitor time since each transponder last produced a trip record in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for missing statement uploads or dead tags, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Toll-tag trip exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Transponder table of days since last trip.
grandmaExplanation: It checks time since each transponder last produced a trip record so you can spot missing statement uploads or dead tags before it becomes annoying.
